source.description: Same-quality original ATF icon pixels. Each RGB value is selected from an actual source PNG pixel nearest the per-quality RGBA median; no tinting, AI, or geometric redraw of the rim. The common quality-2 alpha supplies the original outer silhouette. A circular grayscale erosion of radius 6 opens the transparent centre; the radius-3 content clip overlaps underneath the rim to avoid antialiasing seams.

excluded.reason: extra-wide artwork; no stretching or guessed alignment
extra-wide artwork; no stretching or guessed alignment

source.sourceOrder: Each quality source-index PNG indexes its quality sources in this manifest, zero-based; equal-distance pixels use the first source.
source.limitations: ATF was lossy and every icon was baked with a character. This is a documented reconstruction of common original pixels, not recovery of an original independent production layer. Fine compression variation remains, including the top highlight. No character/background colour is retained in the transparent centre, and no background layer was inferred.

referenceMask.usage: Original independent black shield overlay retained for reference; not substituted for the five rarity rims. The aligned baked-icon common alpha is used for the generated clip geometry.

source.copyright: Original game artwork; rights remain with the original rights holders, as described in repository README.

maskSemantics: L image: 0 excludes content, 255 includes; full native 103x118 canvas coordinates.
drawingSemantics: Default content is behind the rim; an explicit foreground mask can place selected character pixels above it.
